title: Projection Optimization: A General Framework for Multi-Objective and Multi-Group RLHF

source_version.publication: Proceedings of the 42nd International Conference on Machine Learning, PMLR volume 267 (2025)
source_version.version_basis: official publisher linked PDF acquired on retrieval date, frozen by SHA-256

summary: Three core proof/estimator failures and bounded unrestricted-linear-reduction failure; local internally corrected formula inconsistencies. No complete policy regret or empirical score failure asserted.

problems.title: Negative-power target sensitivity is not Lipschitz as claimed
problems.location: Lemma C.2 p37; Eqs31-36 pp23-25 and Eqs50-54 pp28-31
problems.assumptions: m2,p-1,c1,B2; epsilon>0, alpha=(1-eps^4,eps^4), alpha_prime=(1-eps,eps), x=(1+eps²,eps²); all weights/coordinates positive, ||x||inf<2
problems.check: Exact boundary membership and ball exclusion; distance>=sqrt(eps)-eps² versus claimed4sqrt2(eps-eps^4)
problems.counterevidence: No whole-policy regret lower bound; restrictions away from zero might change continuity constants

problems.title: Malfare expansion omits factor q
problems.assumptions: q2,m1,B1,W=[1,infty),Vt0,T100; admissible scalar zero-reward pessimistic offline instance with balanced preference dataset
problems.check: 100000000>99440199; missing orderT3 cannot be absorbed by orderT2 remainder
problems.counterevidence: Example's actual regret gap zero; q1 coefficient correct
problems.impact: Offline malfare proof and later online reuse
problems.correction: Verified local Taylor bound with2q and Hessian remainder; downstream rate not re-proved

problems.title: Probability-sum weight estimator is inconsistent
problems.location: Eq11 p8; Algorithm4; TheoremB4 Eq57 p32 versus LemmaD1 p38
problems.claim: Vanishing estimation error for printed probability-sum argmax
problems.assumptions: One prompt, binary responses, two identical r=1{y1}, scalar theta1 fixed by common uniform baseline C.5; betaB1,p1,c2,alpha*(.75,.25),gamma.5,kappa1
problems.check: Informative pairs P(I1)=sigmoid(2a-1); probability-sum argmax tends a1, infinity error.25
problems.result: Estimator consistency claim false as printed
problems.counterevidence: Log-likelihood is clearly intended; identical rewards allow optimal policies despite wrong weights
problems.impact: Core online weight-learning guarantee; no claimed policy regret lower bound
problems.correction: Sum log probabilities; scalar clipped log-odds estimator verified consistent on example

problems.title: Unrestricted linear-special-case reduction ignores orthant
problems.location: Example3.1 p5 and p7 direction claim
problems.claim: Distance to positive-orthant target equals unrestricted halfspace distance
problems.check: Linear optimum q=sigmoid(.901) has negative S2, active corner; reducing q by.01 lowers distance while lowering linear objective
problems.counterevidence: Preceding paragraph explicitly restricts Pi for a related statement; imposing that restriction excludes witness but is not enforced by stated oracle
problems.impact: Bounded to exact unrestricted linear reduction; independent distance objective remains meaningful
problems.correction: For p1 remove orthant or explicitly enforce S>=0 constrained policies; neither repairs all nonlinear theory

problems.title: Reward-free displays have corrections within same paper
problems.location: p6 versus p4/E2p41; E3p42 opening versus own proof andAlgorithms3/4
problems.claim: Extra reference factor in product policy and wrong sign in reward-free identity
problems.assumptions: Normalized directions; one-objective constant reward example with reference(.75,.25)
problems.check: Extra factor produces(.9,.1) instead of optimalreference; correct product and plus sign already present elsewhere
problems.counterevidence: Correct derivations/algorithm expressions already supplied; no implementation establishes wrong branch used
problems.impact: Minor local defects, not additional proven core rate failure
problems.correction: Use already-supplied pure product and plus-last-term identity
